notablePrerequisites:
Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
Scrapyard Recombiner does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Scrapyard Recombiner by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Scrapyard Recombiner.
Resolve the Lesser Masticore trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Scrapyard Recombiner ability, causing you to search your library for a Construct card and put it into your hand.
Repeat.
